rules.description: Exclude any candidate interval whose window-expanded locus intersects an annotated feature of the listed classes. Incomplete or unreliable annotation of the locus must not default to pass: the rule verdict is unknown and blocks screened-candidate classification.

Exclude candidate loci that contain, or lie within window_bp of, ab-initio repeats (unit length >= min_repeat_length_bp) or annotated repeat/mobile-element classes; homology blocks drive recombination-mediated excision, duplication and rearrangement instability.

Exclude any candidate locus that overlaps, or lies within proximity_window_bp of, a gene essential per any listed source (union semantics). If essentiality status is unknown for an overlapping gene, the verdict is unknown and blocks screened-candidate classification.

Exclude candidate loci within origin_exclusion_window_bp of the replication origin. When expression evidence is present, also exclude loci flanking genes in the top high_expression_exclude_percentile of expression; when evidence is absent the sub-check stays unknown and blocks screened-candidate classification.

Exclude candidate loci whose window_bp-expanded locus intersects annotated regulatory elements or contains any sequence motif of sequence_motif_table; short functional motifs are disruption and interference hazards (v0 table: E. coli Chi site, a RecBCD recombination hotspot).

Advisory, non-excluding: flag candidate loci within flag_window_bp of annotated mobile/island features (prophage, genomic island, integron, CRISPR array) for manual review of context-dependent instability. Never overrides the verdict of any mandatory rule.
